title: 033 - Submit Button State
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print enabled when the form is not loading, has no errors, and can submit and prints exactly `enabled`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
<?php

function submitButtonState(string $text, string $query): bool
{
    return str_contains($text, strtolower($query));
}
solutionCode:
<?php

function submitButtonState(string $text, string $query): bool
{
    return str_contains(strtolower($text), strtolower($query));
}
hint: One of the booleans is negated incorrectly.
explanation: The broken logic disables the button even when submission is allowed. Fixing the boolean expression restores the expected state.
